title: StandardizedLoggerConfig
description: Configuration object for initializing an AutomationLogger. Defines output destinations, formatting modes, and log level behavior.

name.description: Unique logger identifier used as the logging namespace and tag across all outputs.

log_level.description: Minimum severity level that will be emitted. Log events below this threshold are ignored.

file_path.description: Base filesystem path for writing persistent log files. Enables file logging when set.

rotation_days.description: Number of UTC calendar days before a new log file is created. Rotation occurs at day boundaries.

console_pretty.description: Enables human-readable log output to standard error for interactive and development use.

console_level_icons.description: Adds visual severity indicators to console logs. Applies only to human-readable output.
